description:
## Goal

Make ProductMemo the sole authority for settled materialized, ABI, backend, and executable-index products. Delete PullSession's parallel typed inventories without re-cloning the shared handles introduced by fz-tfn.9.

## Combined-head truth

The parallel maps still exist as transition state, but equal reproduction now retains one canonical `Rc` across producer, memo, side inventory, downstream products, World projection, direct result, cache hit, and fresh session. The side maps no longer justify a second value authority: their remaining consumers ask inventory questions that typed iteration over settled memo keys/values can answer.

ExecutableEffects storage is separate and leaves through fz-tfn.8 with its private effect graph.

## Strategy and TDD

1. Inventory every producer and consumer of materialized, ABI, backend, and executable-index side maps; classify the exact query each asks.
2. Add only the typed ProductMemo iteration/query surface required by live queries.
3. Move production consumers and assertions to memo-owned products while preserving the same canonical handles; no conversion may deep-clone an inner payload.
4. Prove identical materialized set, executable index, settled keys, product generations, root artifact, causal telemetry, and pointer identity.
5. Delete the four maps, record APIs, mirror invalidation, concordant RootProjection plumbing made unreachable, and transition-only tests/docs.
6. After mirrors are gone, census every nested `Rc`. Remove a nested handle when the sole remaining owner already guarantees the same lifetime; retain it only with a test that names two independent owners.

## Acceptance

ProductMemo is the only settled product authority. No compatibility mirror, re-cloned payload, output-key cache, or duplicate invalidation path remains. Full product/ownership tests, library, serial fixture matrix, three-door behavior, causal determinism, formatting, check, strict clippy, and docs pass.
title: Delete PullSession's parallel artifact side maps
